_meta.about: Coverage map consumed by tools/ableton/gen-coverage.mjs. Keys are '<Class>.<member>' or '<Class>.*' globs; values {via, ref, note?}. via: tool = typed kbot handler (kbot_ext.py + ableton_lom/ableton_browser/ableton_structure), lom = generic ableton_lom get/set/call plane, osc = stock AbletonOSC address (upstream 0ca6821 + local edits, enumerated 2026-08-18 from ~/Music/Ableton/User Library/Remote Scripts/AbletonOSC/abletonosc/*.py), ui = the LOM cannot do it; Live menu path for Plane D, na = constant/record class, not addressed. Anything not listed defaults to via:lom (properties: get/set, methods: call). Exact keys win over globs; classes listed in _inherits fall back to their base class entries.

sources.osc: AbletonOSC handlers: song.py track.py clip.py clip_slot.py device.py scene.py view.py application.py midimap.py

_meta.tool_action_naming: TS action names as shipped in packages/kbot/src/tools/ableton-lom.ts (reconciled 2026-08-18 against the code, not the address): ableton_lom get|set|call|describe|children|exec|snapshot|snapshot_file|list|ping; ableton_browser search|load|preview|stop_preview|presets|load_preset|insert_device; ableton_structure create_track|delete_track|duplicate_track|delete_device|move_device|set_device_active|insert_chain|add_macro|macros|build_pad|clip_notes (op=get|set|add|remove)|quantize|automation|arr_create_clip|arr_dup_from_session|arr_clips|undo_begin|undo_end|data_get|data_set|dialog_press|message. The raw /live/kbot/* handler is named where its arg forms are wider than the TS action (e.g. track/delete return:N, clip/notes/get <clip path>). Refs are written as '<tool> <action> <params>'.
_meta.reconciled: 2026-08-18: refs rewritten to the shipped TS action names; via flipped to lom for members no typed handler actually touches (Application.show_message, Browser.hotswap_target, Browser.colors, Browser.legacy_libraries, BrowserItem.is_selected/source, Chain.delete_device, Clip.clear_envelope, Clip.set_notes, RackDevice.remove_macro, Song.find_device_position); Clip.add_new_notes / remove_notes_extended stay osc (stock address verified) with the clip_notes op=add|remove path named in the note.
